messages.subject: shiny, dplyr, filter - reactive column
parts:
Hi, 

I have an app the has two inputs input$factor1 (single column selection) and input$factor1_levels (can be a group of choices) as choices from a larger data.frame. I would like to use the dplyr::filter() function to dynamically allow a user to filter based on the two inputs. For example code:

# does not work in shiny
factor1 <- in_file %>%
      group_by_(input$factor1) %>%
      filter(input$factor1 %in% input$factor1_level) 

# does work when I actually specify the column name within shiny
factor1 <- in_file %>%
      group_by_(input$factor1) %>%
      filter(account_credit %in% input$factor1_level) 

I'm reading about NSE (non-standard evaluation) but I can't wrap my head around applying that for shiny and dplyr. Could I specify a .dots function and change to dplyr::filter_() in shiny to make the filtering reactive?

Thanks!
